$comment: Process identity strings; the daemon compares them byte for byte with what it reads itself (internal/processidentity). Linux and WSL: 'proc:PID:starttime:T', T being field 22 of /proc/PID/stat, i.e. index 19 of the whitespace-split text after the LAST ')' (the command name may contain spaces and parentheses); T must be a positive integer. Windows: 'pid:PID:start:NS', NS = (creation FILETIME - 116444736000000000) * 100, the creation time in Unix nanoseconds.
